sourceSemantics.scope: Only this one current LVF Pod wrapping/unwrapping and configured-pair liquidity target. LVF leverage/lending/staking and generic zaps not admitted.
details: Static deployment-bound ABI/source inventory, not fresh runtime bytecode/storage identity, balances, allowance, liquidity, financial-safety or successful-execution assurance. Exact grants, canonical calldata/value validation, pauses and independent controls remain mandatory.

Ethereum pPEAS target is beacon proxy 0x5A3FBC343516cF9aFa35f2753259496de5eeeb45. Explorer currently reports WeightedIndex implementation 0x50D2aCb0d9ee43c39dcf7CF694E94A0F9187491a. Its runtime embeds beacon 0x1e45673d425a0e9b27e6688bbec53ea9f22f2d8a; beacon owner may upgrade all related pods. Do not treat the beta deployment as immutable or substitute the legacy pOHM pod.

All selected calls are nonpayable and require zero native value. Underlying wrapping asset is 18-decimal PEAS 0x02f92800F57BCD74066F5709F1Daa1A4302Df875; shares are pPEAS. bond pulls each configured underlying from caller with allowance, rounds proportional input upward, and enforces amountMintMin after fees; no deadline. Registry currently reports a single PEAS underlying, but no fresh storage attestation is made.

debond burns/transfers caller pPEAS and immediately returns proportional underlying to caller after fee, with downward rounding and no minimum output or deadline. The address[] and uint8[] ABI arguments are deliberately unnamed and ignored by this actual WeightedIndex body: they do not encode routes or target calls. Config debondCooldown is not used in this implementation debond, so there is no delayed claim or cooldown bypass entry despite generic docs discussing optional cooldowns.

Fees use denominator 10000. Official current registry snapshot reports bond 20 (0.20%), debond 80 (0.80%), buy/sell 200 (2% each), fee-burn allocation 1000 (10%), partner 0; not independently read on-chain. First wrap and eligible first partner wrap can avoid wrap fee; last-out threshold >=99% of circulating supply and rewards-whitelisted callers avoid debond fee. Tiny amounts can round to zero shares/output. Fee whitelist/config dependencies remain authoritative.

addLiquidityV2 uses caller pPEAS internally without pPEAS allowance and pulls paired asset using allowance; paired asset is pfWETH-2 0xD1538A9d69801E57c937F3C64d8C4F57d2967257, NOT raw WETH or ETH. Adds to fixed configured pod/paired V2 pool via configured DEX_HANDLER. Slippage is /1000 (100 means 10%); >1000 underflows, 1000 allows zero minimum. It returns actual caller LP balance increase and refunds unused balances; no min-LP-output argument.

removeLiquidityV2 pulls configured V2 LP tokens using allowance to pod, returns pPEAS and paired pfWETH-2 to caller through configured adapter with per-token minimums and deadline; lpTokens=0 consumes caller entire LP balance. Adapter/pool/rewards configuration is initialized, not caller-selected arbitrary target/payload. No generic zap, leveraged router, flash callback, staking contract, permit, approval, donation burn, setup or admin method is admitted.

debond can trigger accumulated fee conversion through configured adapter/rewards contracts, using zero swap minimum and 20-second fee-processing delay. Third-party token behavior, reward-hook failures, existing blacklist storage, upgrades and dependency changes can revert ordinary calls. No KYC restriction appears in these selected contract bodies; frontend/legal eligibility is not waived.

ignoredArguments.debond(uint256,address[],uint8[]): Both trailing arrays unused by actual WeightedIndex implementation, independently checked in full bound source; not an opaque route/executor.

sourceSemantics.accounting: _totalAssets internal accounting and _totalSupply circulate excluding flash-minted supply. bond floors share ratio then rounds asset transfer up; redemption floors share ratio and underlying output. Fee units DEN=10000.
sourceSemantics.authority: Operations act on _msgSender shares/funds and pay caller; no delegated owner/receiver/operator parameters. Beacon owner can upgrade. CREATOR-only pool-linking initialization and partner-only fee reduction/partner replacement excluded.
sourceSemantics.configuration: Registry configuration snapshot is not fresh storage. Current WeightedIndex debond does not inspect config.debondCooldown; no request/claim implementation exists. Core principles generic immutability language is expressly beta-qualified and not used to override beacon source.

lifecycleEvidence.excerpt: Current docs describe Pods wrapping base tokens, Volatility Farming, Leveraged Volatility Farming and beta exceptions to no admin keys/upgrades. Optional cooldown in generic docs not assumed to apply to this implementation.

Official live frontend API includes this exact Ethereum Peapods PEAS LVF Pod with nonzero lending_pair, not the UI legacy-pods category. This is current primary deployment/lifecycle evidence; token balances/TVL are not used as prerequisites or claims.
